items.source: Create a fetch join for the given property.
items.translation: 为给定属性创建 Fetch Join。

items.source: Implementations adapt a From and expose typed fetch methods accepting PropertyReference instances to avoid string-based attribute navigation.
items.translation: 实现方式适配了 `From` 接口，并暴露了类型化的获取方法，这些方法接受PropertyReference实例，以避免基于字符串的属性导航。

items.source: Strategy interface used by Expressions.fetch(From, PropertyReference) to obtain fetch joins using property references.
items.translation: Expressions.fetch(From, PropertyReference) 所使用的策略接口，用于通过属性引用获取连接。
